card.name: Small words before everyday society nouns
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation (on, as, about, to, a comma, a dash) in general web prose where a noun about public life or daily services is expected next, such as government, schools, housing or health care.

modes.label: Linking word before a civic noun
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction right before a noun for public services or daily life.
modes.example: Nobody ever asks me "did you vote?" when I gripe<< about>> the government.

modes.label: Comma or dash in a list of services
modes.description: Punctuation inside a list of social goods like care, education, housing and transport.
modes.example: the costs of items in the family budget other than food<<—>>utilities, housing, transportation, child care

modes.label: Place name before families
modes.description: A place-name word followed by community nouns.
modes.example: the effect the influenza pandemic had on Roseau <<County>> families

card.writes: It pushes toward public-life nouns like traffic, buses, stores, schools and employment, and away from equipment and Chinese business terms.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words when the next word is likely a community or public-service noun like schools, stores or buses.
